explanation: Admission sodium was 127 mEq/L, chloride 101 mEq/L, bicarbonate 9 mEq/L, and albumin 1.8 g/dL. Using the standard potassium-excluding formula, anion gap = 127 − (101 + 9) = 17 mEq/L. Albumin-corrected anion gap = 17 + 2.5 × (4 − 1.8) = 22.5 mEq/L. No unit conversions are required, and the result falls within the accepted range.

The pretreatment values are sodium 143 mEq/L, chloride 120 mEq/L, bicarbonate 12.5 mEq/L, and albumin 2.1 g/dL. No unit conversions are needed. Anion gap = 143 − (120 + 12.5) = 10.5 mEq/L. Albumin-corrected anion gap = 10.5 + 2.5 × (4 − 2.1) = 15.25 mEq/L. The albumin-corrected delta gap (corrected anion gap minus the normal reference of 12) is 3.25 mEq/L, within the accepted range.
